item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Urvashi's graph compares English and Hindi marks for Divya, Kabir, and Neel with adjacent bars, one common scale, and a legend.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims correctly describe how the graph is built?

options.A: For each student, two adjacent bars share the category, use the same vertical scale, and the legend separates English from Hindi.
options.B: Bar heights on the common scale can be compared across English and Hindi for the same student.
options.C: The display is finished by naming it a double column graph, without comparing any bar heights.
options.D: Drawing the clustered bars is what creates the English and Hindi marks.
